character.description: A hand-drawn science-fiction street action scene used to validate illustrated cel-animation effects

style.name: hand-drawn-cel-animation-effects
style.description: High-quality hand-drawn cel animation still inspired by serious late-1980s and 1990s Japanese science-fiction animation, with illustrated smoke, fire, sparks and rain that read as authored animation drawings rather than 3D particles or volumetric simulation
style.medium: traditional cel-animation style ink linework and painted animation backgrounds
style.period: late-1980s to 1990s analogue animation production language
style.lighting: overcast rainy night with motivated sodium streetlight and fire illumination

puddled reflections painted into the background

continuity_locks: preserve a coherent hand-drawn cel-animation visual language across every effect element

shots.description: Rainy industrial city street immediately after a small mechanical explosion, with smoke, flame, sparks, rain, wet pavement and drifting steam all visibly illustrated as hand-drawn cel-animation effects
shots.pose: no hero pose; environmental action composition
shots.camera: eye-level cinematic wide shot, natural perspective, strong foreground-midground-background separation
shots.expression: tense environmental aftermath rather than character portrait emotion
shots.background: dense but readable industrial Japanese science-fiction street with utility poles, concrete facades, drainage, rain and wet asphalt
shots.framing: wide environmental composition with comfortable margins around the main smoke and fire shapes
